key.answer_key: Not cleanly. Reading panel F3a shows that after cycle ~85 the EC-based capacity partly recovers (from about 60 up to about 82 mAh/g), and the error bars on that trace span roughly +/-40 mAh/g, so the figure qualifies the simple 'collapse from cycle 45 onward' reading rather than confirming it outright.
